summarization: This smartphone UI screen displays an advertisement for Google AdWords. The main content includes a promotional message encouraging users to see if Google AdWords can work for them. There is a prominent call-to-action button labeled "Get Going Today." The ad is branded with the Google AdWords logo at the bottom. Additionally, there is a small "X" button in the top-left corner to close the ad, and a refresh icon in the bottom-right corner, likely to reload or change the ad content.
